alias.markdownDescription: The sf CLI alias of the org, or `{ env: NAME }`, the variable that holds it, so each pipeline points the role at its own org. `--alias <role>=<alias>` on the command line wins over it, and an unset variable refuses every command but `validate`, exit `2`. An alias holds no space and does not start with `-`. Credentials stay with the sf CLI: log the org in there.

ruleType.markdownDescription: How the field is masked: `fake` writes a made-up value, an email under `example.invalid`; `mask` writes `*` over its characters but the last `maskKeepLast`; `hash` writes a pseudonym, the same value giving the same pseudonym across the run; `nullify` empties it; `shuffle` reorders its characters; `preserve_format` writes `x` for each letter and `0` for each digit; `constant` writes `constantValue`; `truncate` keeps `truncateLength` characters. No rule carries a salt: the run draws its own key.

object.markdownDescription: The object it masks, by its API name, as `Contact`. Without it, every object its rules mask, Account’s person accounts among them where the org has them. A rule set with no rule for it is refused before any org is reached, exit `2`: a run would mask nothing.

where.markdownDescription: With `object`: a SOQL condition, without `WHERE`, selecting the records it masks, as `Email != null`; every record of the object without it. Select them by a field its rules leave as it is: once masked, records selected by a field the rules write over read as gone. 512 characters at most, with no comment marker (`--`, `/*`, `*/`), no `;` at its end, and not starting with `-`.

oneOf.markdownDescription: A mask resource: records the org already holds, a sandbox copied from production, masked by `sandforge-dataops` with DataOps rules, after a snapshot of the values it writes over, kept on this machine. It creates no record, and `destroy` never unmasks: it deletes the snapshots. Putting the values back is `sandforge-dataops anonymize --restore`, before a destroy.

additionalProperties.markdownDescription: A resource of the environment: its `kind`, `seed`, `forge`, `frozen` or `mask`, says what it is and which keys it takes.

resources.markdownDescription: What the environment holds, by name: each resource says its `kind`, `seed`, `forge`, `frozen` or `mask`, and the keys that kind takes. Applied in the order `dependsOn` and `from` give, and destroyed the other way. A name is lower-case letters, digits and dashes, and none is shaped like a secret; 100 resources at most.
